title: qgb JSON Patch document (Phase 2 subset)
description: JSON Patch subset accepted by `qgb patch` (Phase 2 Step 2.2). RFC 6902 subset: add / replace / remove / test only. move / copy are reserved for Phase 3 and rejected at the schema layer along with the `from` field.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string '' addresses the root. Validation of escapes and array indices is enforced at apply time (qgb/core/patch.py); the schema only checks the type.

value.description: Required for add / replace / test. Forbidden for remove.

then.description: Step 2.2 補修 A3 (Codex / subagent correctness 中): RFC 6902 §4.2 で remove op は value を禁止。`not: {required: [value]}` (旧) は value 必須を否定するだけで存在を許してしまうため、`properties: {value: false}` で value 出現自体を schema reject する形に変更。
